checkOutcomes.evidence: Screenshot comparison plus CSS feature probe: the dark condition remains light and no preference rule exists.
Animation probe under reduce reports 18 infinite animations still running.
Contrast condition remains unchanged and CSS contains no forced-colors/prefers-contrast handling.
Same-origin MPA chart navigation has no view-transition CSS or transition naming.
CSS and interaction inspection found no scroll-linked effects and no JavaScript scroll-animation anti-pattern; ordinary scrolling stays native.
The audited pages preserve native document scrolling; the scratch surface confines touch-action:none to its canvas and presents a large direct-manipulation target.
The mobile page is 48,496px tall but offers no progress/scroll-state cue; fixed promotional chrome is static.
No tooltip, anchored menu or edge-positioned popover exists on the representative pages; the only overlay is a centered modal-like surface.
checkOutcomes.reason: No anchored overlay surface exists to test.

checkOutcomes.evidence: 321 generic Jodi/Panel labels and no current-location cue make destination changes hard to follow.
Load screenshots on desktop and mobile show the core content immediately; the premium overlay is hidden until interaction.
The premium modal is a plain DIV with no dialog semantics, modal state, or labelled close control.
Screenshots show pervasive boxed chrome, decorative motion and three fixed controls obscuring the mobile content edge.
Jodi and Panel templates each report 8px overflow at a 360px viewport.
Reusable result/chart blocks use viewport media queries only; no container query support was found.
Focus remains visible, but repeated links measure about 41x26px and six visible controls are below 24px in one dimension.
The first viewport clearly identifies live Matka results, current lucky numbers and links to chart types.
The homepage links resolve directly to representative Jodi and Panel charts, and the game URL loads with actionable market tabs.
Refresh/unlock actions expose no status live region or explicit loading/error/retry state in the inspected DOM.
Lighthouse reports LCP 1.3s, CLS 0 and TBT 0ms; trace reports LCP 750ms and TBT 27ms.
Observed CLS was 0, but the image audit found a rendered spinner without intrinsic width/height reservation.
Trace found two modest long tasks, longest 72.69ms, with only 26.98ms total blocking time.
HAR shows only five requests, 72,079 transferred bytes, no render-blocking candidates, redirects or HTTP errors.
The page loads with no external JavaScript/CSS bundles and only five network requests; third-party byte cost is zero.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse a11y audits and DOM probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse identifies large data tables without headers/captions; the custom overlay close control is not descriptively named.
Lighthouse measured failing normal-text contrast ratios of 3.57:1 and 4.14:1.
No landmarks were found and Lighthouse reports non-sequential heading order; focus itself is visibly outlined.
Screenshots show dense 12–14px all-bold/italic copy and tightly packed historical tables over very long pages.
Chart templates overflow at 360px and repeated controls are only about 26px high; viewport does not prohibit scaling.
Lighthouse best-practices scored 1.0 and reported no console-error or uncaught-exception audit failure.
Doctype/charset are valid, but one image lacks dimensions and repeated inline markup/styles dominate the large document.
Lighthouse best-practices scored 1.0; no deprecated API, prompt-on-load, paste prevention or vulnerable-library failure was reported.
The page has a descriptive title and non-empty meta description in both rendered and raw HTML.
Viewport and robots are valid, but five hash-only links and 321 generic link labels reduce crawl and destination clarity.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM plus robots/sitemap fetch and route probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Main document returns 200, canonical points to the HTTPS homepage, robots allows it and declares a populated sitemap; no accidental noindex was found.
Three JSON-LD blocks exist, but Open Graph title/description are generic and no image metadata was reported for the specific result content.
HTTPS is used and the sole Cloudflare cookie is Secure/HttpOnly, but CSP, HSTS and nosniff are absent.
HAR reports zero third-party bytes; tracker scan found no known trackers and secret scan found no exposed credentials.
No authentication or permission-requesting surface appears on the representative pages, and no forms or credential controls were found.
checkOutcomes.reason: The audited public result and game surfaces have no auth or permission flow.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent alongside CSP/HSTS.
Discoverability comparison reports 100% raw-HTML coverage, no empty mount and content visible without JavaScript.
Representative pages load complete server-rendered content with no async dependency shell; centered overlay geometry remains bounded within the viewport.
This is a public results/content site rather than an installed app; no declared offline user journey was found.
checkOutcomes.reason: Installability is not necessary for the representative content/result journey.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A deliberate unknown route returns HTTP 404 with a branded, non-blank response; normal audited routes return 200.
Substantial Hindi content sits under global lang=en-in; no language spans, dir strategy or logical CSS properties were found.
The game renders an English date in mixed-language UI with no evidence of locale-aware Intl formatting.
The audited surfaces expose result labels and a calendar date but no user-facing event time, scheduling flow, stored timestamp or cross-zone coordination.
checkOutcomes.reason: No time-zone-sensitive user data or scheduling behavior is present.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Prominent “Trusted”, “Fix Ank”, “VIP” and instant-withdraw claims steer users toward gambling/APK flows without visible substantiation or risk context.
No form fields or form submission flow exists on the representative pages.
checkOutcomes.reason: There is no authored form to validate.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No text, address, payment, sign-in or sign-up inputs exist on the audited paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: There are no user inputs requiring autocomplete assistance.

checkOutcomes.evidence: VIP, APK download and unlock actions do not expose pricing, commitment, cancellation or operator context before entry.
Two images lack responsive sources; the below-fold PNG lacks lazy loading and modern-format delivery.
HAR records five requests and 72KB total; trace shows only 27ms blocking and no background request chatter.
No video/audio loads, third-party transferred bytes are zero, and the full load is 72KB across five requests.
Recon found a public read-only results site with no declared intent to expose transactional agent tools; crawler-readable content is already fully server-rendered.
checkOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing capability or transactional tool scope is declared for this site.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation, generation or language-model task is part of the audited result/chart journey.
checkOutcomes.reason: On-device inference would not improve the observed core task.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten popup open/close cycles, DOM nodes remained 2,411; heap summary grew only 99,361 bytes (about 1.4%), consistent with runtime warm-up rather than unbounded retention.
Baseline heap is 7.26MB with 95,100 snapshot nodes and 2,411 DOM elements, proportionate to the unusually long server-rendered page.
DOM node count is unchanged after ten cycles and neither heap constructor summary reports a Detached* population.

principleOutcomes.reason: All checks were judged not applicable to this site’s declared or observed purpose.

paths.description: Homepage and primary results index; represents initial orientation, current results, giant market listing, global metadata and security.
Representative Jodi historical chart template selected from hundreds of same-template market routes.
Representative Panel historical chart template selected to cover the second main data-table archetype.
Representative interactive VIP/free-game journey covering unlock controls, tabs and stateful content.

findings.summary: The site does not adapt to the user’s dark theme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is visually identical to the normal screenshot, and the CSS probe found no color-scheme declaration or prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven surface and text colors with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Continuous decorative motion ignores reduced-motion.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, 18 animations remained running, including the 5s infinite spinner, 10s marquee and repeated 2s text animations.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a reduced-motion media query that removes non-essential infinite animation and preserves only necessary state changes.

findings.summary: The visual system does not adapt to increased contrast or forced colors.
findings.evidence: The increased-contrast screenshot remains unchanged; the CSS probe found no prefers-contrast or forced-colors handling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add forced-colors and prefers-contrast adaptations for borders, text, controls and focus indicators.

findings.summary: Navigation between the homepage and chart templates swaps abruptly.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection across the MPA templates found no @view-transition rule or view-transition-name, despite frequent chart navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin chart navigation and disable them under reduced motion.

findings.summary: The extremely long homepage provides no meaningful position or progress cue.
findings.evidence: Layout measured a 48,496px mobile document, while the CSS probe found no scroll-state query or progress indicator; only fixed promotional buttons remain in view.
findings.suggestedFix: Add lightweight scroll-position feedback or sectional navigation and let sticky chrome react without obscuring content.

findings.summary: Repeated generic link labels make navigation difficult to follow.
findings.evidence: The probe counted 321 generic links, largely “Jodi” and “Panel”, across 388 anchors, forcing users to infer each destination from surrounding blocks.
findings.suggestedFix: Give each link a self-contained accessible label such as “Kalyan Jodi chart” and group markets into searchable, collapsible navigation.

findings.summary: The premium overlay is an unlabelled custom div rather than a dialog.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found .premium-popup as a DIV with no dialog element, role, aria-modal or accessible relationship; its close button is only “×”.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the custom modal container with <dialog>, label it, use showModal()/close(), restore focus and retain Escape/light-dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: Dense borders, gradients, animation and fixed promotions overwhelm the results content.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots show nearly every block boxed in bright multi-color borders, while three fixed buttons cover content at the bottom of the phone viewport.
findings.suggestedFix: Establish a restrained type/color hierarchy, remove decorative borders and continuous effects, and reserve fixed chrome for one primary action.

findings.summary: Chart templates overflow the narrow viewport.
findings.evidence: At a requested 360px viewport, both Jodi and Panel layouts reported scrollWidth 368 and 8px horizontal overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove default body margins or fixed table sizing and use max-inline-size:100%, overflow wrappers for data tables, and intrinsic sizing.

findings.summary: Reusable market and chart components respond only to viewport breakpoints.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found media queries but no container-type or @container rules across the homepage and chart templates.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable chart/market wrappers containment and adapt typography/actions with container queries where they appear at different widths.

findings.summary: Many repeated chart links are undersized touch targets.
findings.evidence: The probe found visible controls as short as 26px and six controls below 24px in at least one dimension; the repeated Jodi links measured about 41×26px.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive targets toward 44×44 CSS px, add spacing, and preserve the currently visible native focus outline.

findings.summary: Refresh and unlock actions lack explicit loading, success and recovery feedback.
findings.evidence: The inspected flow exposes repeated Refresh and Tap to Unlock actions, but no status/live region or visible retry/error state was found; the game screenshot leaves results hidden without explanatory failure handling.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose pending/success/error states in an aria-live status, prevent duplicate activation, and provide retry/cancel paths.

findings.summary: Data tables and overlay controls lack robust semantics.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports large result tables whose data cells have no associated headers and fake captions implemented as colspan cells; the modal close control is only “×”.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <caption>, <th scope>, explicit table relationships, and accessible names for icon-only controls.

findings.summary: Some text fails WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured #d63b3b on #ffe08a at 3.57:1 and #bb2833 on #ffcc99 at 4.14:1, below the 4.5:1 threshold for normal text.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken foreground colors or simplify backgrounds until all normal text reaches at least 4.5:1.

findings.summary: The document lacks landmarks and has an illogical heading hierarchy.
findings.evidence: The structural probe found no main, nav, header, footer or aside landmarks; Lighthouse flags heading order, including an H6 after unrelated sections.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce semantic landmarks and rebuild headings as a consistent outline based on sections rather than visual size.

findings.summary: Dense, tiny and all-bold text harms reading and chart comprehension.
findings.evidence: Screenshots show long paragraphs at roughly 12–14px, cramped line-height, all-bold italic text and dense tables across documents up to 48,496px tall.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a readable base size and line-height, normal weight for body copy, constrained line lengths and progressive disclosure for historical tables.

findings.summary: Chart templates do not fully reflow and targets are too small.
findings.evidence: Both chart archetypes overflow by 8px at 360px, and repeated chart controls are roughly 26px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix reflow at 320–400px and 200% zoom, wrap wide data tables, and enlarge targets without disabling user scaling.

findings.summary: Image delivery and authored markup have avoidable hygiene problems.
findings.evidence: The image audit found one image without dimensions, one below-fold image not lazy-loaded, two without responsive sources and one legacy PNG; DOM inspection also shows extensive repetitive inline content/styles.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic image dimensions, lazy-load below-fold imagery, provide responsive modern sources, and consolidate repeated markup/styles.

findings.summary: Hundreds of links use non-descriptive or non-destination hrefs.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe counted 321 generic labels and five href="#" links among 388 anchors, even though viewport and robots configuration are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real destination URLs and unique link text that names both market and chart type.

findings.summary: Share metadata is too generic for the page’s visible content.
findings.evidence: Open Graph title and description are only “Satta Matka”/“SattaMatka” and no OG image was reported, while the visible page contains specific dated results and market data.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate accurate page-specific Open Graph metadata and validate existing JSON-LD against visible entities and dates.

findings.summary: The HTTPS response lacks baseline browser security policies.
findings.evidence: Header inspection found no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, clickjacking control, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and a minimal Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defenses are not configured.
findings.evidence: Neither CSP frame-ancestors nor X-Frame-Options is present, and Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are also absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors, a strict referrer policy, a deny-by-default permissions policy, and consider Trusted Types after removing inline script dependencies.

findings.summary: Mixed-language content is labelled only as English and uses no logical-property strategy.
findings.evidence: The page contains substantial Hindi text while <html lang="en-in"> applies globally; the CSS probe found no logical inline/block properties and no dir handling.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark language changes with lang attributes and replace directional physical CSS with logical properties so translation and bidi layouts remain robust.

findings.summary: Visible dates are hard-coded rather than locale-aware.
findings.evidence: The game surface renders “18 July 2026” inside mixed Hindi/English content, while DOM/CSS inspection found no locale-selection or Intl-driven formatting evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Format user-facing dates with Intl.DateTimeFormat using the selected content locale and preserve machine-readable datetime values.

findings.summary: The page presents gambling predictions and app downloads with misleading trust and certainty cues.
findings.evidence: The first mobile viewport promotes “Trusted Matka Play App”, “Fix Ank”, “VIP Zone”, “Sabse Tezz” and “Instant Withdraw” without balancing risk, provenance or limitations; these cues direct users toward APK downloads.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove guaranteed/trusted/fix claims unless independently substantiated, label promotions, disclose gambling risk and operator identity, and make external APK destinations explicit.

findings.summary: VIP and app flows do not disclose operator, pricing or commitment before activation.
findings.evidence: The inspected entry and game surfaces expose VIP Zone, Download App and Tap to Unlock actions without visible pricing, terms, cancellation or reauthentication context in the primary flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Show operator identity, price and commitment before entry; provide clear terms, cancellation and confirmation; avoid sideloaded APKs where a safer store/web flow is available.

findings.summary: Image assets are not fully optimized for their context.
findings.evidence: The image audit found no srcset on two images, a below-fold PNG without lazy loading, and no modern-format image among the externally loaded assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive AVIF/WebP sources, add intrinsic dimensions and lazy-load the below-fold decorative spinner.

findings.summary: A below-fold spinner has no reserved intrinsic dimensions.
findings.evidence: The image audit found spinner.png without width/height attributes. Current sampled CLS was 0, but the element has no markup-level space reservation and can shift under different timing.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width and height (or aspect-ratio) matching the spinner’s intrinsic dimensions while retaining responsive sizing.

taskList.title: Remove deceptive gambling certainty cues and disclose operator, risk, pricing and commitment before VIP/APK actions
Rebuild landmarks, heading/table semantics, labels and descriptive chart links
Replace the custom premium overlay with a labelled native dialog and explicit state feedback
Add reduced-motion, dark-theme and high-contrast preference adaptations
Simplify chrome and improve body typography, contrast and mobile target sizes
Fix chart-template overflow and adopt intrinsic/container-responsive component sizing
Deploy CSP, HSTS, nosniff, framing, referrer and permissions policies
Optimize and dimension images, including responsive modern formats and below-fold lazy loading
Correct language metadata and locale-aware date formatting
Improve share metadata, scroll orientation and optional cross-document transitions
